message.content:
**Screenshot 1: Essay Reading View**
*   **Text Overlap/Cut-off:** None observed. The text is well-contained within the main content column. The sidebar and navigation are clean. (10/10)
*   **Alignment:** Excellent. The drop cap 'C' aligns perfectly with the body text. The "Contents" sidebar, header, and metadata are all strictly grid-aligned. (10/10)
*   **Contrast:** High. White/light grey text on a deep navy/black background provides excellent readability. The cyan accent on the "Copy Link" button is vibrant but not harsh. (9/10)
*   **Visual Quality (New Elements):** The typography hierarchy is distinct and professional. The layout feels spacious and "cinematic" as requested. (9/10)
*   **Overall Rating: 9.5/10**

**Screenshot 2: Publications Section (Wide)**
*   **Text Overlap/Cut-off:** None. The empty state message is centered and has ample padding. (10/10)
*   **Alignment:** Perfect. The section number (04), title, and description are left-aligned consistently with the rest of the site. The filter bar and empty state container are centered correctly within the grid. (10/10)
*   **Contrast:** Good. The "honest empty state" text is legible. The faint constellation line-art in the background is subtle enough not to distract but adds depth. (9/10)
*   **Visual Quality (New Elements):** The constellation background is a nice touch that fits the physics theme without being cheesy. The hourglass icon is clear. The "Filter" pills look modern. (9/10)
*   **Overall Rating: 9.5/10**

**Screenshot 3: Publications Close-up**
*   **Text Overlap/Cut-off:** Identical to Screenshot 2 at this zoom level. No issues. (10/10)
*   **Alignment:** Holds up under closer inspection. Spacing around the filter tags looks uniform. (10/10)
*   **Contrast:** The subtle grid lines in the background are visible here; they add to the "blueprint/laboratory" aesthetic nicely. (9/10)
*   **Visual Quality (New Elements):** The line-art nodes (dots) connect smoothly. The visual weight of the empty state balances the heavy header above it well. (9/10)
*   **Overall Rating: 9.5/10**
